University: Tokyo University of Agriculture and Technology (TUAT)
Paper_Title: Static and Dynamic Measurements of Spindle System During Rotation by Noncontact Electromagnetic Loading System
Research_Question_RQ: Can noncontact electromagnetic loading accurately measure static stiffness and dynamic compliance of machine tool spindle systems during high-speed rotation without mechanical contact artifacts?
Methodology_and_Models: Noncontact electromagnetic exciter/loading device, magnetic force calibration, HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) simulation of intermittent milling forces, transfer function estimation.
Dataset_and_Scale: Rotational speeds up to 10,000+ rpm, excitation frequencies up to 2,000 Hz, static load up to hundreds of N, displacement measured via capacitive/eddy current displacement sensors.
Validation_Type: Physical experimental rig + rotating spindle bench test + HIL dynamic simulation
Quantitative_Results: Author-reported measurements confirmed rotational centrifugal softening and thermal drift effects; dynamic compliance peaks matched within measurable SNR bounds.
Author_Stated_Limitations: Eddy current sensor calibration affected by target material runout and electromagnetic flux leakage; thermal expansion during long continuous rotation requires secondary compensation.

University: Tokyo University of Agriculture and Technology (TUAT)
Paper_Title: Evaluation of dynamic compliance of machine tool spindle based on coil current estimation
Authors_Year: Iwai, T., Yamato, S., Matsubara, A. (2025)
Research_Question_RQ: Can drive coil currents in electromagnetic actuators substitute for external load cell force measurements to estimate spindle dynamic compliance in real-time?
Methodology_and_Models: Analytical electromagnetic force-current relationship, back-EMF decoupling, sensorless force estimation, FRF computation.
Dataset_and_Scale: Multi-frequency sinusoidal sweep excitation, spindle bearing bench test setup.
Validation_Type: Benchtop experimental validation comparing estimated force vs load cell measurements
Quantitative_Results: Estimated dynamic compliance matched direct force gauge measurements within acceptable industrial error margins for primary resonance modes.
Author_Stated_Limitations: High-frequency magnetic hysteresis and eddy current losses degrade force accuracy above 1.5 kHz without complex nonlinear magnetic compensation.
Evidence_Level: E2 (Abstract/conference archive verified; awaiting full published print)

Paper_Title: Modeling Machine-Stand Vibration Based on Multibody Dynamics Analysis Considering Contact in Support Mechanisms
Authors_Year: Watanabe, T., Mizoguchi, T., Seki, K., Iwasaki, M. (2025)
Research_Question_RQ: How can structural vibration of machine tool stands with nonlinear contact interfaces at leveling mounts be accurately modeled in multibody dynamics (MBD)?
Methodology_and_Models: Nonlinear contact mechanics (Hertzian contact model with friction damping), multibody dynamics formulation, parameter identification via frequency response matching.
Dataset_and_Scale: Full-scale machine stand test structure, sinusoidal sweep vibration excitation, accelerometers at 8 measurement points.
Validation_Type: Physical experimental testbed + MBD numerical simulation comparison
Quantitative_Results: Modal frequency discrepancies between simulation and experiment reduced significantly compared to linear rigid mount models across 10-200 Hz range.
Author_Stated_Limitations: Parameters identified under specific pre-load conditions; extrapolation to varying foundation stiffness and aging of elastomer pads requires re-identification.
Evidence_Level: E3 (Full text methodology and experimental verification confirmed)

Paper_Title: Parameter identification of nonlinear vibratory systems using physics-informed/grey-box neural networks
Authors_Year: Tajiri, D., Kawamura, S. et al. (2024)
Research_Question_RQ: Can grey-box neural networks reliably identify linear mass/damping/stiffness parameters and unknown nonlinear restoring forces from noisy vibration time series?
Methodology_and_Models: Physics-informed grey-box neural network architecture: linear parameters preserved in ODE layers while neural net approximates arbitrary nonlinear restoring forces; gradient optimization.
Dataset_and_Scale: Synthetically generated vibration data for Duffing oscillator, Van der Pol oscillator, and friction models; white Gaussian noise levels added up to 10% SNR.
Validation_Type: Pure numerical simulation + synthetic noise sensitivity testing (NO physical machine testbed)
Quantitative_Results: Identified linear stiffness and damping parameters within 1-3% relative error under moderate noise; reconstructed nonlinear force curves accurately.
Author_Stated_Limitations: Algorithm verified ONLY on synthetic 1-DOF and 2-DOF ODE models; unvalidated on complex distributed structural dynamics or physical industrial machine tools.
Evidence_Level: E3 (Full text method/synthetic data verified; E4 limitation acknowledged: No physical hardware data)

Paper_Title: Vibration suppression of layered structural systems with additional dynamic absorbers
Authors_Year: Tajiri, D., Kawamura, S. et al. (2025)
Research_Question_RQ: What is the optimal tuning strategy for auxiliary dynamic vibration absorbers mounted on multi-layered structural panels under wideband random excitation?
Methodology_and_Models: Modal expansion method, finite element beam/plate formulation, genetic algorithm-based H-infinity and H2 optimization of absorber parameters.
Dataset_and_Scale: Layered composite beam specimens, electrodynamic shaker benchtop excitation, laser Doppler vibrometer measurements.
Validation_Type: Experimental shaker testbed + FEM numerical simulation
Quantitative_Results: Resonance amplitude of primary bending modes suppressed by over 12 dB compared to bare panel structure.
Author_Stated_Limitations: Performance sensitive to absorber mounting location tolerances; damping oil temperature variations alter tuned frequency over extended operation.

Paper_Title: Energy-based analysis and experiment for self-synchronization of two rotors installed in two-DOF translational system
Authors_Year: Mori, H., Inoue, T. et al. (2025)
Research_Question_RQ: What are the stable phase synchronization regimes of dual unbalanced rotors mounted on an elastically supported translating frame?
Methodology_and_Models: Averaging method, energy balance analysis, Poincaré-Hopf theorem for stability bifurcations, nonlinear ODE integration.
Dataset_and_Scale: Custom-built dual-rotor experimental rig, optical encoders for phase angle tracking, tri-axial accelerometer for base vibration.
Validation_Type: Experimental bench test + theoretical bifurcation diagram + numerical time-domain ODE integration
Quantitative_Results: Experimental phase difference stabilized at 180 deg (anti-phase) in predicted speed bands; base vibration reduced by ~80% during locked synchronization.
Author_Stated_Limitations: Synchronization range narrows significantly when motor speed difference exceeds 3%; transient spin-up phase requires active torque matching to prevent desynchronization.

Paper_Title: In-process thermal error compensation and dynamic cutting force monitoring for five-axis machining centers
Authors_Year: Sugita, N., Yoshioka, H. et al. (2023-2024)
Research_Question_RQ: How can spindle thermal elongation and tool tip dynamic deflection be decoupled and compensated in five-axis milling operations?
Methodology_and_Models: Finite element thermal-structural coupling, fiber Bragg grating (FBG) optical strain sensors embedded in spindle housing, recursive least squares estimator.
Dataset_and_Scale: 5-axis CNC machining center, continuous dry and wet milling tests, touch probe verification over 6-hour thermal cycles.
Validation_Type: Real machine tool cutting test + in-process workpiece dimension metrology
Quantitative_Results: Workpiece volumetric machining error reduced from 45 microns to under 12 microns over full thermal cycle.
Author_Stated_Limitations: Embedded sensor installation requires specialized spindle assembly modifications; model coefficients vary with coolant temperature dynamics.
Evidence_Level: E3 (CIRP Annals / Journal full paper methodology verified)

Paper_Title: Evaluation and compensation of geometric and thermal errors in rotary axes of multi-axis machine tools using tracking interferometer
Research_Question_RQ: Can dynamic multi-line tracking interferometers measure 6-DOF motion errors of high-speed tilting rotary tables simultaneously?
Methodology_and_Models: Homogeneous transformation matrices (HTM), multilateration algorithm, thermal error modeling using neural network regression.
Dataset_and_Scale: 5-axis machine tool rotary table (B/C axis), laser tracker with 4 base stations, ambient temperature variations 18-28 deg C.
Validation_Type: Full-scale machine tool geometric metrology under thermal disturbance
Quantitative_Results: Angular error measurement repeatability within 0.5 arcsec; combined volumetric error compensation improved positioning accuracy by 65%.
Author_Stated_Limitations: Interferometer beam occlusion during specific table tilting angles; optical alignment requires extensive setup time before cutting runs.
Evidence_Level: E3 (Full paper methodology and experimental metrology verified)

Paper_Title: Chatter vibration suppression in thin-walled milling using variable pitch tools and active damping mechanism
Authors_Year: Suzuki, N., Shamoto, E. et al. (2023-2024)
Research_Question_RQ: How do unequal pitch cutting edges interact with thin-walled workpiece dynamic compliance to prevent regenerative chatter?
Methodology_and_Models: Regenerative chatter stability lobe theory, semi-discretization method (SDM), time-domain milling simulation with state-dependent tool-workpiece contact.
Dataset_and_Scale: High-speed machining of titanium and aluminum thin webs, Kistler dynamometer force data, acoustic microphone, eddy current displacement sensors.
Validation_Type: Physical machining cutting tests on CNC vertical machining center
Quantitative_Results: Critical stable depth of cut increased by 2.4-fold compared to standard uniform pitch cutters in thin-walled finish passes.
Author_Stated_Limitations: Wear on cutting edges changes optimal pitch stability envelope; requires conservative parameter selection under severe tool degradation.
Evidence_Level: E3 (Full text simulation and experimental cutting test verified)
